messages.subject: Time recording reminder - October
messages.plaintextBody:
James, our records show 14.5 hours of unrecorded time for October against your matters. Please ensure all time is posted by close of business Wednesday so we can run the November bills. Thank you.

Accounts
Whitfield Carter LLP
